statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), count actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets once by their vertex sets and put d_T=6-r_T for each actual triangle. Suppose R=227, every d_T belongs to {0,1,2}, and exactly five actual triangles have deficiency two. Suppose further that every vertex used by the deficiency-one triangles lies in exactly two of them. Let S be that selected vertex support. It is impossible that exactly one outside-S vertex lies in any deficiency-two triangle.
